kit: Greenery — shrubs, flowers, grass, shore plants, drift weed
generated: Generated for the px + greenery + harmony drop. Art numbers are read from each family manifest; collision, occluder, hazard and speed are declared here and marked as such per entry.

units.pivot: bottom-centre ground contact unless a family says otherwise

legend.block: none = walk through · soft = push through at speed_mul · solid = collide
legend.occluder: true if the sprite should sort over and hide a body behind it (roughly: 1.2 m and up)
legend.footstep_overlay: a second sound layer over the ground material footstep, not a replacement

grass.provenance: every frame read from GrassSpecies.json / GrassVarieties.json; collision and the 0.95 brush cost DECLARED.

shore_plants.sheets: NOT baked into this drop — the rig renders them (11.42 MB across 16 species × 4 variants × 2 seasons × 5 tides). Same as export/shore-plant-rig-kit; run the rig on the engine side or ask for a sheet bake.

tide.input: water height over the plant’s own ground = tideM - zone.base. Maps onto the painted seabed height plus the deterministic tide; no new sim.
tide.waterRow: row index in sprite space where the surface crosses. null when the surface is outside the sprite — read `submerged` to tell which side.

shore_plants.keyline_defect: The shore rig outlines every plant with KEYLINE #101d21; the pixel kit is ringless and has no black in any palette. Composited together, a rockweed is a black-edged sticker on a floor that cannot make that colour. harmonyScenes.js re-cuts the ring as band 0 of the plant own dominant colour; it belongs in the rig as an option (defect 05, open).

frame.m: water-plane metres relative to buoy: mx=(x-buoy.x)/32, my=(y-buoy.y)/(32*0.72) (+y toward camera/south)
frame.pivot: buoy (buoyancy centre) — register the sprite to the water surface here

drift_weed.snag_note: Every variant publishes buoy (register to the water surface), snag points (exact frond-tip px + water-plane metres) and a dragTail. No catch radius is defined anywhere in the kit; DriftWeed.json _confirm proposes 0.1 m as the engine default — still unconfirmed.
drift_weed.provenance: everything read from DriftWeed.json; collision DECLARED (a floating raft is a fouling volume, not a wall).

_excluded.harvest: No pick/cut/forage hooks: not requested. They would hang off the species keys here.
_excluded.sway: No sway or phenology frames are baked in this drop. Shrub phenology is 8 phases in Art/shrubIsoRig.js, flower stages/sway are in Art/flowerRig.js, shore-plant sway is 4 frames × 3 modes in the rig.

_confirm.footprints: Every collision radius is derived from the SPRITE cell or the published width, not from a measured trunk or stool. For soft and none that is harmless; for alder (the one solid) it is generous — halve it if bodies snag.
_confirm.occluder_threshold: 1.2 m is a rule of thumb, not a ruling. Bayberry at 1.2 is the borderline case and is set true.
_confirm.shore_sheets: The shore-plant sheets are not in this drop, so nothing here has been checked against a baked sprite — only against the rig contract.
_confirm.tide_and_grip: Drained algae carry slip, and so does the rockweed GROUND material in TerrainPx.gameplay.json. Applying both on the same texel double-counts; let the ground material win.
